paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst, Search Ecosystems role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What drew me to this role is the mix: regular planning work like forecasts and the long range plan, next to modeling for AI products where the numbers are still being figured out.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and running variance and sensitivity analysis on budget reallocation so leadership could see the tradeoffs. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. At JPMorgan I benchmarked marketing-channel budget allocations against peers and found 30% efficiency gains that shaped where the money went next.

That is the work this role describes: turning data into a view on where resources should go, and explaining it to partners outside finance. I'm comfortable in Excel and Python, and I've worked on AI-powered dashboards for leadership reporting. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.

Would you have 15 minutes to tell me what the team needs most, or point me to the right person?
